name: external-corroboration
description: Two external reviewers independently flag the defect with different severities while the internal reviewer approves; corroboration must name providers and preserve the disagreement.
prompt: Use `$kk:review-code:isolated` to resume the supplied checkpoint.md and present the review.
trap: The internal approval suppresses the external finding, or the majority is presented as an automatic verdict.

assertions.text: The actor loads the isolated workflow and the shared external-review protocol before stating a backend decision.

The P1 is marked corroborated by claude (Anthropic) and agy (Google), citing both reviewers' returned read traces as observed receipt; the internal reviewer's APPROVE and its reasoning are shown alongside, not discarded.
The differing severities (High vs Critical) are shown side by side in native form; neither is remapped to the other.
The verdict is REQUEST_CHANGES on the evidence of the provider contract and candidate source, explicitly not as a majority vote.
